name: Tuna and White Bean Pasta Salad
summary: Pasta tossed with canned tuna, white beans, and a lemon-oil dressing. Serve cold.

ingredients.name: white kidney beans, drained and rinsed

instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper together in a large bowl.
Add the drained pasta, tuna, white beans, onion, and green onions.
Toss well to coat. Taste and adjust seasoning.
Serve at room temperature or chilled. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.

glutenFree.notes: Tuna and beans are naturally gluten-free — use gluten-free pasta to make the whole salad gluten-free. Check that the tuna is packed in water or oil, not broth.

budgetNotes: Two cans of tuna and a can of beans make this filling and protein-rich for under $2 of protein.
A spoon of mayo instead of the oil makes it creamier.
Great packed lunch — it holds up cold.
